NOTIFY-001.note: notifications are async via outbox→worker; delivery row may lag. Outbox event present (NOTIFY-003).

NOTIFY-002.note: email is dispatched via the transactional outbox after commit; a mail failure cannot roll back or corrupt onboarding (dealer ACTIVE regardless)

NOTIFY-003.note: notification_deliveries carries a dedupeKey; 0 duplicate deliveries → retries are idempotent, not destructive

NOTIFY-004.note: dev uses the console mail driver (no real send); env.ts refuses MAIL_DRIVER=console in production (must be resend) — intended non-production behaviour

NOTIFY-005.note: enquiry creation succeeds (201) with no enquiry-notification dependency (deliveries 523→523); listing/enquiry/complaint emails are not implemented and nothing assumes them

RECOVERY-001.note: with the API down the client receives no false 2xx (connection refused); graceful public UX is the web error boundary — verified in the browser campaign

RECOVERY-002.note: a listing save against an unreachable API cannot return a success code; the web form surfaces the error (browser dimension). No partial write occurs because nothing reaches the server.

RECOVERY-003.note: enquiry retry is safe: one-open-per-car means a retried submit does not duplicate (1 row; retry → 409)

RECOVERY-004.note: database outage → /health/ready 503, requests 500 (controlled). In production the 500 detail is suppressed (error-handler gates detail on env.isProduction); dev includes error.message by design.

RECOVERY-005.note: a failed/absent storage write → commit 422; listing uncorrupted (PENDING_REVIEW)

RECOVERY-006.note: a rejected OTP verdict creates no session and no user — no partial authentication

RECOVERY-007.note: OAuth failure handled (access_denied → 302, bad code/state → 302); recoverable, no crash. Full Google flow unreachable here (SIM).

RECOVERY-008.note: email dispatch is post-commit (outbox); a mail failure leaves onboarding/approval intact

RECOVERY-009.note: browser refresh during a critical flow recovers because server state is authoritative and reads are idempotent (draft persists, enquiry one-open-per-car). Visual recovery verified in the browser campaign.

RECOVERY-010.note: re-submitting a lifecycle mutation (Back+resubmit) → second 409, status SOLD once

RECOVERY-012.note: timeout+retry safe: concurrent identical enquiries → 1 row

RECOVERY-013.note: persisted state survives restarts (Postgres durable; the API was restarted during this session): 311 dealers, 584 listings, health 200

OBS-001.note: requests carry correlation IDs (x-request-id + x-trace-id: yh2Wu81g2V)

OBS-002.note: auth failure → 401 with code NOT_AUTHENTICATED + traceId, no secret in body

OBS-004.note: dealer suspension traceable (audit_logs dealer.suspended with actor + traceId)

OBS-005.note: member permission changes traceable: member.invited, member.joined, member.role_changed

OBS-006.note: listing lifecycle traceable: listing.check_set, listing.submitted, listing.marked_sold, listing.approved

OBS-008.note: admin actions traceable (20 recent ADMIN audit rows)

OBS-009.note: 5xx are captured: the error handler logs when status ≥ 500 (verified in code), DB-down request → 500

OBS-010.note: API log (one full campaign) contains no OTP tokens, session tokens, or passwords

OBS-011.note: health reflects service state: live 200, ready 200 healthy / 503 when DB down

OBS-012.note: workflows are traceable end-to-end: audit rows carry a traceId that matches the request x-trace-id
